How It Works

From DM to doorstep

Every order is confirmed with you on WhatsApp before anything is finished or sent.

i.

Message us

ii.

Confirm the price

We confirm the unit and price with you directly, with no surprises.

iii.

Finishing

iv.

Pick-up or delivery

Collect your unit or arrange delivery with us.
